floorPlans.label: Aldar Athlon brochure and layouts
floorPlans.introduction: Compare the published townhouse, standard villa and premium villa layouts. The six-bedroom premium example includes its second floor.
floorPlans.note: These drawings illustrate typical layouts. Confirm the signed plans and areas for the selected home and release.

review.images: The official Athlon brochure provides distinct townhouse and premium villa elevations and the clubhouse, activity bridge and villa interior renders. Several standard villa and interior images also appear in The Wilds villa brochure. Those shared scenes were excluded from this gallery. JPEG 2000 source images were converted to lossless WebP for browser delivery.
review.location: Physical page 9 shows the Athlon master community. The map and running copy agree on the community but give 30 and 25 minutes to DXB, respectively. The discrepancy is shown in the note and omitted from the numeric destinations.
review.floorPlans: Visually checked all eight published townhouse and standard and premium villa sheets, including three levels on page 65. Property Finder hosts seven matching plan images. Some portal area entries cannot be reconciled with the sheet labels, including the five-bedroom premium example. No unverified area was assigned to a drawing.

unavailable: Drawing-specific signed floor areas, confirmed cluster entrances and a single consistent airport travel time.
